name: Airport Planning and Operations
description: Overview of aviation sector; forecasting demand-passenger, freight, peaking characteristics; aircraft characteristics; airport planning: requirements, site selection, layout plan; geometric design of runway, taxiway and aprons; airport capacity-airside, landside; airport pavement systems: design, maintenance, and overlay; air cargo facilities; airport safety and readiness; terminal operations- passenger, cargo; environmental impact of airports; airline scheduling; airport financing and economic analysis.
